qa.what_happened: The study was abruptly ended after six days. During the private debrief with the lead researcher, I found myself describing my experiences, including the feelings of monotony and the sense of being a pawn in an experiment.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me recounting my thoughts and experiences from the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment.
